title: 📐️ semio repo domain model
$comment: 🧬️ The wire contract of 🦑️repo's domain model. One $def per domain type, with the exact JSON member names the Go struct tags declare; a member absent from `required` is the `omitempty` half of that tag. Generated from 📦️packages/🦀️rust/🦀️.rs by $TICKET/🗑️generated/model/build-schema.ts so the schema and both implementations cannot drift. The slug vocabularies live beside this file in 🔣️allowed-values.json, which every implementation embeds.

DefinitionKind.$comment: 📖️ What a definition is, derived from the raw keyword a language plugin reports.

BreachPriority.$comment: 🔸️ How urgently a breach must be dealt with.

TechnologyKind.$comment: 🛠️ Which family a technology belongs to. The wire value is the technology emoji itself.

FolderKind.$comment: 📁️ Whether a folder is required by a toolchain or purely organisational.

FileKind.$comment: 📄️ What role a file plays. The Go twin keeps these as bare string constants.

SemanticChangeType.$comment: ♻️ How an entity changed between two checkpoints.

Range.$comment: 💿️ A closed line range inside a file.

DiffLines.$comment: 🟩️ The concrete line numbers a diff touched.

CountMetrics.$comment: 🟦️ Added, updated and removed entity counts.

AnalyzeMetrics.$comment: 🔬️ Aggregate breach statistics of an analyze run.

Repo.$comment: 💠️ The repository itself: the root of every artifact id.

Technology.$comment: 📜️ A technology: the first grouping level under the repo root.

Bundle.$comment: 🔵️ A bundle: one buildable unit inside a technology.

Package.$comment: 🔴️ One published package produced by a bundle.

Section.$comment: 💗️ A named region inside a file, possibly nested.

Definition.$comment: 💕️ A single declaration inside a section.

ContributorIcons.$comment: 🤝️ Rendered avatar links of a contributor.

ContributorLink.$comment: 🔗️ A named external link of a contributor.

ContributorTicket.$comment: 🤍️ A ticket a contributor worked on, as stored in the contributor record.

ContributorCheckpoint.$comment: 🔀️ A checkpoint a contributor authored, as stored in the contributor record.

ContributorContributionsStorage.$comment: 🖤️ The persisted contribution index of a contributor.

Contributor.$comment: 🧑️‍💻️ A person or agent that contributes to the repository.

ContributorDefinition.$comment: 🔖️ Line totals a contributor owns inside one definition.

ContributorSection.$comment: 🔖️ Line totals a contributor owns inside one section.

ContributorFile.$comment: 🔖️ Line totals a contributor owns inside one file.

ContributorFolder.$comment: 🔖️ Line totals a contributor owns inside one folder.

ContributorBundle.$comment: 🔖️ Line totals a contributor owns inside one bundle.

ContributorContributionsTree.$comment: 🌳️ The expanded contribution tree of a contributor.

ContributionBundle.$comment: 🔖️ Count metrics of a contributor against one bundle.

ContributionFolder.$comment: 🔖️ Count metrics of a contributor against one folder.

ContributionFile.$comment: 🔖️ Line metrics of a contributor against one file.

ContributionSection.$comment: 🔖️ Line metrics of a contributor against one section.

ContributionDefinition.$comment: 🔖️ Line metrics of a contributor against one definition.

ContributorContributions.$comment: 🔖️ The contribution index of a contributor, keyed by artifact id.

Checkpoint.$comment: ✔️ A committed checkpoint of the repository.

CheckpointDiffRename.$comment: 💾️ A from/to pair for a renamed entity in a checkpoint diff.

CheckpointDiffStats.$comment: 🆕️ Deleted, renamed, modified and created entities of one diff category.

CheckpointDiff.$comment: 📁️ The full entity diff of a checkpoint.

Interaction.$comment: 🟫️ One recorded exchange between a contributor and the repository.

InteractionResource.$comment: 🎁️ An interaction flattened together with the artifact it was recorded on.

TicketPlan.$comment: 🧷️ An IDE-native plan or spec file archived into the ticket folder on close.

TicketAgentPlanStep.$comment: 🎫️ One step of an agent's plan on a ticket.

TicketAgentPlan.$comment: 💠️ The plan an agent declared on a ticket.

TicketAgent.$comment: 🔳️ One agent session recorded on a ticket.

TicketManagementData.$comment: 🐙️ The management-provider link of a ticket.

Ticket.$comment: 🔖️ A ticket: one unit of work with a lifecycle and a contribution record. The Go twin carries a hand-written `UnmarshalJSON` that additionally rewrites goal and contributor compose-ids and absorbs pre-schema field spellings. Both belong to `🪪️identity` and `🎫️tickets`; this crate is the pure shape.

TicketData.$comment: ◼ The persisted subset of a ticket, without any derived field.

TicketDate.$comment: 🟪️ Creation and completion timestamps of a ticket.

TicketFile.$comment: ◾ A file a ticket touched, with its line metrics.

TicketDiffSet.$comment: 🗃️ The four change classes of one entity level.

TicketDiffs.$comment: ◻ The semantic diff of a ticket across every entity level.

TicketSectionMetrics.$comment: 📑️ The metrics a ticket accumulated inside one section.

TicketSection.$comment: ▫️ A named section a ticket touched.

TicketFileMetricsEntry.$comment: 📍️ The metrics a ticket accumulated inside one file, keyed by section name.

TicketFileMetrics.$comment: 🎫️ Section metrics of one file, keyed by section name.

TicketBundleMetrics.$comment: 📦️ File metrics of one bundle, keyed by file path.

TicketSectionContrib.$comment: 🔖️ The definitions and metrics a ticket touched inside one section.

TicketFileContrib.$comment: 🔖️ The sections a ticket touched inside one file.

TicketBundleContrib.$comment: 🔖️ The files a ticket touched inside one bundle.

GoalManagementData.$comment: 🟡️ The management-provider link of a goal.

Goal.$comment: 🔵️ A goal: the long-lived intent that tickets are opened against.

Draft.$comment: 💿️ A draft: a named set of files staged before a ticket exists.

Todo.$comment: ✅️ A todo recorded against an artifact.

Statute.$comment: 🟢️ The slash-separated identifier of a statute, for example `code/section/empty`. The closed vocabulary and its metadata belong to `📜️statutes`; the model only carries the id so that every artifact type can reference a statute without depending on that module.

Territory.$comment: 🟣️ A named grouping of statutes and nested territories.

StatuteMeta.$comment: 🔖️ The declared metadata of one statute.

Policy.$comment: 🔖️ A policy: a scoped set of territories and statutes.

Breach.$comment: 🔶️ One detected violation of a statute.

AnalyzeResult.$comment: 🔖️ The outcome of an analyze run.

FixResult.$comment: 🔖️ The outcome of a fix run.

SemanticChange.$comment: 🔖️ A single semantic change to one entity between two checkpoints.

BundleMetricsInternal.$comment: 💿️ Entity counts of one bundle in a codebase snapshot.

FolderMetricsInternal.$comment: 📁️ Entity counts of one folder in a codebase snapshot.

FileMetricsInternal.$comment: 📄️ Entity counts of one file in a codebase snapshot.

SectionMetricsInternal.$comment: 📑️ Entity counts of one section in a codebase snapshot.

DefinitionMetricsInternal.$comment: 📖️ Entity counts of one definition in a codebase snapshot.

FileRange.$comment: 🔶️ A start/end position pair inside a file.

BreachFile.$comment: 🔹️ The file a codebase breach points at.

BreachFolder.$comment: 🔸️ The folder a codebase breach points at.

CodebaseBreach.$comment: 🔺️ A breach as stored in a codebase snapshot.

CodebaseBundle.$comment: 📦️ A bundle as stored in a codebase snapshot.

CodebaseFolder.$comment: 🔻️ A folder as stored in a codebase snapshot.

FileBreachRef.$comment: 🔗️ The statute a file-level breach reference carries.

CodebaseFile.$comment: ⬛️ A file as stored in a codebase snapshot.

CodebaseSection.$comment: ⬜️ A section as stored in a codebase snapshot.

CodebaseDefinition.$comment: 🟥️ A definition as stored in a codebase snapshot.

ContributorBundleContrib.$comment: 🤝️ A contributor's count metrics against one bundle in a snapshot.

ContributorFolderContrib.$comment: 🟧️ A contributor's count metrics against one folder in a snapshot.

ContributorFileContrib.$comment: 🟨️ A contributor's line metrics against one file in a snapshot.

ContributorSectionContrib.$comment: 🟩️ A contributor's line metrics against one section in a snapshot.

ContributorDefinitionContrib.$comment: 🟦️ A contributor's line metrics against one definition in a snapshot.

ContributorContributionsInternal.$comment: 🟪️ The full contribution index of a contributor in a snapshot.

ContributorMetricsInternal.$comment: 🟫️ Aggregate counts of a contributor in a snapshot.

CodebaseContributor.$comment: 💠️ A contributor as stored in a codebase snapshot.

TicketDateInfo.$comment: 🎫️ The created/finished dates of a ticket in a snapshot.

TicketBundleContribInfo.$comment: 🔳️ A ticket's count metrics against one bundle in a snapshot.

TicketFolderContribInfo.$comment: 🔲️ A ticket's count metrics against one folder in a snapshot.

TicketFileContribInfo.$comment: ▪️ A ticket's count metrics against one file in a snapshot.

TicketSectionContribInfo.$comment: ▫️ A ticket's count metrics against one section in a snapshot.

TicketDefinitionContrib.$comment: ◾ A ticket's line metrics against one definition in a snapshot.

CodebaseTicket.$comment: 🗃️ A ticket as stored in a codebase snapshot.

PolicyBreachRef.$comment: 📜️ The statute a policy-level breach reference carries.

CodebasePolicy.$comment: ◽ A policy as stored in a codebase snapshot.

CbTreeNodeKind.$comment: 🌳️ The entity level of a codebase tree node.

CbTreeNode.$comment: 🌿️ One node of the codebase containment tree.

TreeNodeKind.$comment: 🌳️ The entity level of a monorepo tree node.

TreeNode.$comment: 🌿️ One node of the monorepo tree. The Go twin declares no field tags, so the wire keys are the Go field names themselves.

TreeFilter.$comment: 🧹️ The criteria a monorepo tree query filters by.

TicketNode.$comment: 🎫️ A ticket node of the goal/ticket tree.

GoalNode.$comment: 💿️ A goal node of the goal/ticket tree.

FileListInput.$comment: 💿️ The updated/created/removed file lists a mutation reports.

TicketOpenInput.$comment: 🎫️ The arguments of a ticket-open mutation.

DraftCreateInput.$comment: 🆕️ The arguments of a draft-create mutation.

GoalCreateInput.$comment: 📝️ The arguments of a goal-create mutation.

GoalChangeInput.$comment: ♻️ The arguments of a goal-change mutation.

GoalCloseInput.$comment: 📪️ The arguments of a goal-close mutation.

GoalReopenInput.$comment: 🔓️ The arguments of a goal-reopen mutation.

GoalDeleteInput.$comment: 🗑️ The arguments of a goal-delete mutation.

TicketDeleteInput.$comment: 🔷️ The arguments of a ticket-delete mutation.

TicketCloseInput.$comment: 🔶️ The arguments of a ticket-close mutation.

TicketReopenInput.$comment: 📬️ The arguments of a ticket-reopen mutation.

TicketChangeInput.$comment: 🔹️ The arguments of a ticket-change mutation.

ContributorAddInput.$comment: 🤝️ The arguments of a contributor-add mutation.

TodoCreateInput.$comment: 🆕️ The arguments of a todo-create mutation.

TodoChangeInput.$comment: ♻️ The arguments of a todo-change mutation.

FilterInput.$comment: 🧹️ The criteria a stream or list query filters by.

TicketBundles.$comment: ⬛️ Bundle metrics of a ticket, keyed by bundle id. A Go named map type, so the wire shape is the map itself.

AllowedValues.$comment: 📋️ The shape of 🔣️allowed-values.json, the shared LLM / effort / client vocabulary both implementations embed.
